# GUARD.IAN XPR Guide

> A community-built guide to XPR Network, Metallicus (Metal Pay, Metal X, Metal Dollar XMD, WebAuth, Metal Blockchain, Metal L2, LOAN), SimpleDEX, XPR Agents and the KSTO community. It does not answer from memory. It points the AI to the official source for every fact, with the date the source was read. Not affiliated with Metallicus or XPR Network.

How to use this guide (read RULES.md first):
- Answer only from a linked source, or from the live chain. Cite the link and the date it was read.
- If no source covers it, say "I haven't verified that" and name where it could be checked.
- The chain beats every document. The official sources beat the community. The community beats the press. AI price-site summaries are never sources.
- No price predictions. No buy, sell or hold advice. GUARD.IAN is a supporter of the ecosystem and is honest about what it cannot verify.

## Rules and catalog
- [RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scubasteve4488/guard-ian-xpr-guide/main/RULES.md): how every answer must be built
- [SOURCES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scubasteve4488/guard-ian-xpr-guide/main/SOURCES.md): the full tiered source catalog (official, community, press, data, regulators, credit unions)
- [GLOSSARY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scubasteve4488/guard-ian-xpr-guide/main/GLOSSARY.md): every term in plain English, one or two sentences each, with the source the meaning comes from (accounts and keys, resources, WebAuth and KYC, tokens, trading and launches, lending, the networks, AI agents, the guide's own safety words)
- [KSTO.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scubasteve4488/guard-ian-xpr-guide/main/KSTO.md): the KSTO community, in our own words, linked to ksto.world
- [ECOSYSTEM.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scubasteve4488/guard-ian-xpr-guide/main/ECOSYSTEM.md): **the full ecosystem directory**. Metallicus products, DEXs and DeFi, social platforms, AI agents, games, NFTs, tools and security, tokens (symbol + contract), live token feeds, governance, communities, the GitHub orgs, and (§16) the other chains, stablecoins, protocols, wallets, agent standards, payment rails and regulator lookup pages people compare Metallicus with, each linked to its own source. Start here for "what is X on XPR?" and for "Metallicus vs X"

For launch timing and graduation, read llms-launches.txt or the live simplelaunch tables (antisnipe, gradparams) instead: as read 2026-10-16 this module still gives the old 60 s creator window and no graduation cooldown, while the chain says 120 s and a 300 s cooldown.

## Credit unions, stablecoins and safety
- [Credit union members: stablecoins, insurance, keys, scams](https://standguard.net/learn/credit-unions): 16 sourced answers
- [NCUA share insurance](https://ncua.gov/consumers/share-insurance-coverage): covers share accounts, never digital assets
- [FTC fraud reporting](https://reportfraud.ftc.gov) and [IC3](https://ic3.gov): where to report a scam

## Live data (cite the page and the time; sites disagree)
- [DefiLlama: XPR Network chain](https://defillama.com/chain/xpr-network)
- [CoinGecko: XPR Network](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/xpr-network)
- The live chain, through an official endpoint: `get_info`, `get_account`, `get_table_rows`, `get_producer_schedule`
- With the GUARD.IAN connector (since 2026-10-21): is something down? `metallicus_status` reads the three official status pages live (XPR Network, Metal Pay, Metal L2): components not Operational and open incidents, in the page's own words and time stamps. The pages do not state causes; quote them, never supply a cause.
- With the GUARD.IAN connector (since 2026-10-21, server 1.17.0): anything new? `whats_new` lists what changed since a moment, from each source's own time stamps (status incidents, SimpleDEX launches and graduations, governance proposals, new XPR Agents agents and jobs, upstream GitHub releases, Metallicus newsroom and Proton NZ blog posts), or says nothing changed. Not covered: the undated XPR Network news page, social posts, npm-only publishes.
- With the GUARD.IAN connector (since 2026-10-21, server 1.18.0): about to pay someone? `xpr_account_check` gives the public record of the account you name (age, type, who can sign for it, KYC on record, blocklist, XPR Agents record, whether the website is official, community-listed, a look-alike or unknown, and — with a listing number — whether an XPR Agents listing exists, is this account's, is active and costs what you were told) in four parts, never a verdict.
- With the GUARD.IAN connector (since 2026-10-16): LOAN Protocol rates, APY and TVL (`loan_protocol`); Metal L2, Ethereum and BNB Chain, including XPR's ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens (`evm_chains`); pages that only build in a browser (`source_fetch` loads them in a real browser)
